description: This script manages authentication directories and files for a Docker-related OpenClaw project, providing functions to normalize, determine inclusion, and collect auth directories and files based on provider names, CSV inputs, or overrides.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes an authentication directory path by trimming and ensuring it starts with a dot.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Determines the auth directory to include based on provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Determines the auth file to include based on provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects authentication directories from a CSV string of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth directories based on override environment variable.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Collects auth directories, preferring overrides when available.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects authentication files from a CSV string of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth files based on override environment variable.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Collects auth files, preferring overrides when available.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple string values into a CSV string.
